pages.text: A Switchgleam is an Arcane Gem formed from a purple-spectrum piece of $(l:arcanearchives:items/shapedquartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$(/l) in an asscher cut.$(br2)When activated, a Switchgleam will swap the positions of you and the entity you're looking at, at the cost of one point of charge.$(br2)While held, Endermen within 10 blocks will have their teleportation attempts absorbed.
Salvegleams can be crafted on a $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/gemcutterstable)Gem Cutter's Table$(/l).
